I am writing to refer this patient under the suspected brain and CNS cancer pathway. He has a six-week history of worsening progressive headache, different from previous headaches. The headaches are most severe in the morning on waking and on bending forward, increasing in frequency and severity with no episodes of improvement.

He has also experienced two episodes of a new seizure over the past three weeks. The seizures were witnessed and described as brief tonic-clonic episodes lasting approximately two minutes, with no prior seizure history. He also reports focal weakness in his right arm developing over the past two weeks.

On fundoscopy today I have found bilateral papilloedema, consistent with raised intracranial pressure.
